purpose: Primary-source material-field evidence batch for Australia, Canada and New Zealand priority pathways.
policy: Only exact route claims supported by current official sources are included; promotion still requires evidenceIds and complete material-field coverage.

records.claim: Canada study permit applicants generally need enrolment at a designated learning institution, sufficient funds, admissibility and to satisfy the officer that they will leave Canada when the permit expires; most applicants also need the required acceptance and attestation documents.
records.methodology: Direct review of current IRCC study-permit eligibility and document guidance.

records.claim: For study-permit applications made on or after September 1, 2026, applicants outside Quebec must demonstrate CAD 23,448 for the first applicant's annual living expenses, excluding tuition and transportation, with higher amounts for accompanying family members; tuition and transportation must also be covered.
records.methodology: Direct review of current IRCC financial-support table and surrounding requirements; Quebec uses separate financial rules.

records.claim: Australia's Subclass 500 Student visa requires applicants to satisfy the applicable student-visa criteria, including the genuine student criterion and the course/visa requirements applicable to the applicant and family members.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Department of Home Affairs Subclass 500 guidance and current genuine-student framework.

records.claim: Where financial-capacity evidence is required for an Australian Subclass 500 application, the applicant must demonstrate funds for travel, 12 months of course fees, 12 months of living costs and applicable school costs for accompanying school-age children; the Department also permits specified alternative income evidence in qualifying circumstances.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Department of Home Affairs Subclass 500 financial-capacity guidance; no universal total is asserted because tuition and family circumstances vary.

records.claim: New Zealand's Fee Paying Student Visa requires an offer of place from an approved education provider and also requires the applicant to meet health, character, genuine-intention, insurance and onward-travel requirements applicable to the visa.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Immigration New Zealand Fee Paying Student Visa guidance.

records.claim: For tertiary, English-language or other non-compulsory study, a self-funded student generally needs NZD 20,000 for each year of study or NZD 1,667 per month for shorter study, in addition to tuition and onward-travel arrangements; acceptable sponsorship or other approved funding mechanisms can also satisfy the requirement.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Immigration New Zealand student-fund requirements.

records.claim: New Zealand's Skilled Migrant Category residence framework requires current skilled employment or an offer of skilled employment at the relevant wage rate and includes pathway-specific qualification, occupational, work-experience and residence requirements.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Immigration New Zealand Skilled Migrant Category change guidance effective August 2026.

records.claim: Skilled Migrant Category applicants must have skilled employment or an offer at the relevant wage rate; current pathway rules use specified wage thresholds for relevant work-experience pathways, so remuneration is route-dependent rather than a single universal settlement-funds amount.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Immigration New Zealand Skilled Migrant Category wage and pathway requirements; route-specific thresholds are not collapsed into one universal figure.
